svg.text: Hi, I'm Mahesh Ketam, an aspiring AI Engineer passionate about solving real-
world problems through Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Next-Gen AI
I love building projects that merge Computer Vision, Natural Language
Processing (NLP), and Agentic AI, leveraging tools like LangChain, LangGraph,
and LLMs to create intelligent and autonomous applications.
